row.evidence: Gainsight documents an Okta SCIM integration for Staircase AI ("Push New Users, Push Profile Updates, Push User Deactivation, Reactivate Users") against https://app.staircase.ai/api/scim, while Staircase AI has no published price, only "Schedule Your Personalized Demo".
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: Staircase AI (acquired by Gainsight; staircase.ai now redirects to gainsight.com/staircase-ai) has no public price; Gainsight's pricing page lists other products only. SCIM is documented by the vendor for Okta only (OIN app, bearer SCIM token from the Okta integration card, base URL app.staircase.ai/api/scim): create, profile update, deactivate and reactivate; unassigning deactivates rather than deletes, and email changes do not sync. SSO is OIDC (SP-initiated) via a custom Okta app. Because the price gate applies first, status is gated (low confidence) even though SCIM is Okta-only; if the price gate is ignored this would be partial.

plans.name: Staircase AI
plans.notes: Gainsight's pricing page lists Customer Success, Skilljar, PX and Communities tiers but no Staircase AI price; the product page only offers a demo.

auth.token_source: Staircase settings (cog) > Integrations > Okta card > SCIM token
auth.notes: Okta 'API Token' field, i.e. a header token; expiry not documented.

operations.notes: Profile updates are supported (Push Profile Updates); whether via PUT or PATCH is not documented. Unassigning in Okta deactivates and does not delete.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated user stays in the team list but can no longer log in.

attributes.notes: Guide shows attribute mapping only in screenshots; the text names only email as the username format and the optional title mapping.

limitations.text: Email address changes are not synced over SCIM.
Only an Okta SCIM guide is published; no Entra, Google, OneLogin or JumpCloud provisioning guide.

user_api.notes: No public Staircase AI user-management API found in Gainsight's Staircase AI documentation.

okta.notes: OIN listing ticks SCIM with Create, Update and Deactivate only (no SAML/OIDC tick); SSO is set up separately as a custom OIDC app per Staircase's Okta SSO guide.

fallbacks.other_sync: Users can be managed through the Gainsight CS integration when Gainsight CS is the CRM.
fallbacks.notes: Organization settings say partner-domain users 'must be invited or synced through SSO'; whether OIDC sign-in creates accounts just-in-time is not stated.
